csv_project_name: Developer for Land Disposal - Wisconsin State Crime Lab
csv_scope_of_work: Northcentral Technical College (NTC) is requesting proposals for the disposal of land through the sale of up to 2.0 acres of existing NTC property to be used solely for the establishment of a Wisconsin State Crime Lab in Wausau, Wisconsin. The southeast corner of the main campus property has been identified as no longer needed by the college due to its remote location and inability to connect to existing campus facilities. The selected developer will work in coordination with the State of Wisconsin to deliver a new Department of Justice (DOJ) crime laboratory and office facility consisting of approximately 28,600 rentable square feet, including required on-site parking for staff, visitors, and State-owned vehicles.
